name: com.commandersolver/levin
title: Levin
description: Fast, certified answers for CBMC and Kani checks too slow for one machine

tools.name: levin_setup
tools.description:
How to send this machine's slow verification checks to Levin: the steps and
        the commands to run. `checker` is "cbmc" (C, C++) or "kani" (Rust). Only the
        numbered SAT formula leaves the machine.

tools.name: levin_job
tools.description:
The record of a finished Levin job: its answer, time, pieces and the fingerprints
        of the proofs that were checked. `job` is the id on the first line of the reply.
